Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the wait on this one.

Your order Shop···· is still with us, unshipped, and it ships on November 7. The B30 batch was held up by the cooling redesign we wrote to you about in September, and your unit is in the batch now being checked in at our warehouse. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but November 7 is the date on your order. The Power K. we added ships in the same box.

One thing I want to get right before it leaves. The order still carries a (address hidden) address, not the (address hidden) one you sent us. I have passed your Georgia address and your phone number to a colleague who is picking it up today so the label is corrected and your number is printed on the package. They will confirm it with you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello André,

I checked it, and you are right. The address on order Shop···· is a forwarder: (address hidden), United States. The ···· is a mailbox number, so that is your usshop.ge account. Your Georgian phone number, (phone hidden), is already on the order and goes on the label.

Hello Sarah,

I thought shipping should be on the way to me, but have not heard anything about that so far.
I need to inform you that I will be traveling begininng of December for some extended time. So if the miner does not reach me within the next two weeks I'll not be able to pick it up or use it. For this reason I would suggest if the delivery is not already on the way we better cancel the order. I'm very sorry....but time is money in the mining business and I'm now waiting for about half a year, which is not cool anymore.

Kind regards

Andre S.

Hi André,

I am sorry. You ordered on 19 July, we gave you 30 September, then 7 November, and your B30 still has not left our warehouse. That is far too long, and I am not going to pretend otherwise.

Where it really stands today: the B30 batch for the US warehouse has not been checked in yet, and the current date on the product is that it ships by 30 November. With your forwarder in Delaware adding a leg on top of that, I cannot honestly promise the unit is in your hands in Tbilisi before you travel in early December. I have put a hold on the order in the meantime, so nothing goes out while we sort this out.

So here is what I can do, whichever you prefer. One, we keep your order and your locked price and simply hold it until you are back, then release it to your forwarder whenever you tell us. Two, we swap it to a Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $349, which is on the shelf at our US warehouse and ships within 2 business days, with the difference coming back to you as store credit on your account. Three, we close the order and put everything you paid on your account as store credit, which never expires and can go on anything we have in stock.

Just reply with the one you want and I will take care of it. If none of them works for you and you would still rather cancel outright, tell me plainly and I will put that request to a supervisor for review.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah,

I take option Four! You cancel the order because it could not be fulfilled in time from your side and you refund the money to my credit-card from where I sent it. I'll be back here in Georgia by second half of march and might see what is on offer (and available) then and make another order.

Kind regards

Andre S.

Hello André,

Understood, and thank you for being straight with me about it. I am sorry we could not get the unit to you in time.

Cancelling with money back to the card is not something we do as a matter of course, so the request goes to a supervisor for review, and I have put it in front of them with everything they need: the order date, the two ship dates we missed, your travel, and the options you turned down. Your order stays on hold in the meantime, so nothing will ship to Delaware while they look at it. The team is away from their desks for the weekend, so they pick this up when they are back in tomorrow and you will get their answer by email in this thread. There is nothing you need to send again.

I will not quote you an amount or a date before they have decided, but I will come back to you here as soon as I have their word.

And if you do look again in March when you are back in Georgia, write to me in this thread and I will tell you honestly what is actually on the shelf before you order anything.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah,

No, from 2 December onwards, no one will be at home and no one will be available on my telephone number from that date either.

And as I wouldn’t be able to set up the system until mid-March anyway, this suggestion doesn’t make sense. I would therefore ask once again that the amount be refunded to my credit card.

Kind regards
